passage:
electricity — 电；电力
The building is old, and the electricity system is weak.

heater — 加热器；暖气设备
If everyone turns on a personal heater, the system may fail.

blanket — 毯子
They said, "We can wear warm clothes, but our hands are still cold." Sarah listened and then said, "You may use a small blanket at your desk.

complained — 抱怨
Some workers complained, "We can work faster with the old computers." Sarah said, "I understand.

save — 节省；节约
The manager, Sarah, explained, "We must save energy because the system is old.

energy — 能源；能量
The manager, Sarah, explained, "We must save energy because the system is old.

empty — 空的
Now, workers must turn off the lights in empty rooms.

miss — 想念；怀念
Tom said, "I can work at home, but I miss my friends." Sarah said, "You may come to the office if you want.
